title: fix(ui): right-click pinned agents to open the full agent menu
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: pinned agents in the sidebar agent roster show a kebab button whose menu only offers Create Claw, so you can't unpin a pinned agent, open its Settings or Sessions, or delete it.

## User Impact

User impact: right-clicking a pinned agent (or pressing Shift+F10 / the context-menu key while it is focused) opens the same agent menu that unpinned roster rows use: Unpin, Sessions, Create Claw when Claws are enabled, Settings, and Delete. Pinned tiles no longer show a kebab. The pin item reads **Pin** with an outlined pin for unpinned agents and **Unpin** with a filled pin for pinned agents. Unpinned rows keep their kebab and also open the menu on right-click.

## Why This Change Was Made

Pinned tiles and roster rows now build their menu from one shared item list and selection handler, so the two surfaces can't drift apart again. Right-click and the keyboard shortcut open that menu at the pointer through the existing point-anchored menu trigger, the same way session rows open their context menus. Unpinning moves keyboard focus to the agent's roster row, matching how pinning focuses the new tile.

Touch: Android long-press fires `contextmenu`, so the menu opens there. iOS Safari doesn't fire it, so pinned tiles on iOS have no menu. That matches the menu-less pinned gallery from before Create Claw added a kebab.

## Evidence

Before: the pinned tile's kebab offers only Create Claw.

![Before: pinned agent kebab menu with only Create Claw](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d9fb3aa3-d9c2-415e-b921-802fe21e6954)

After: right-clicking the pinned tile opens the full agent menu. There's no kebab, and Unpin shows a filled pin.

![After: right-click menu on pinned agent with Unpin, Sessions, Create Claw, Settings, Delete](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1a5ab734-1cf2-4580-8aff-0de33f37ee3f)

After: the unpinned roster row shows the same menu with an outlined Pin.

![After: unpinned roster row menu with outlined Pin](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/66a56df0-27f0-431d-9d7c-6e0399b2b2ec)

- `pnpm test ui/src/components/app-sidebar.pinned-agents.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 8/8 passed (Vitest shard ~10 s). The new case right-clicks a pinned tile, checks the item list and the filled-pin class, unpins, and verifies focus returns to the roster row. It then right-clicks the row and checks for the outlined Pin.
- `ui/src/e2e/sidebar-pinned-agents.e2e.test.ts` (Playwright, bundled build): 6/6 passed at 1440/1366/768/390 px. It covers right-clicking the pinned tile (Unpin, Sessions, Create Claw, Settings, Delete), Shift+F10 from a focused pinned tile, unpinning through the menu, right-clicking the unpinned row, and the computed pin fill (filled when pinned, `none` when unpinned).
- `pnpm check:changed`: typecheck shards and changed-file guards passed. Its Knip dead-export scan reports only existing exports outside this diff. Lint on the touched files is clean (0 warnings, 0 errors).
- Autoreview (Codex, P0–P2): no actionable findings. That review ran before a follow-up commit that only wraps the event handlers for the Solid reactivity lint.

Requested by @Patrick-Erichsen.
